title: x-version
description: Lifecycle and status metadata for Arazzo workflows. Unified shape shared across OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, and Arazzo pillars. Deprecation metadata lives inside this extension — there is no standalone x-deprecated. See Arazzo Handbook §4.2.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this workflow version

deprecatedAt.description: ISO date when this version was deprecated. Required when status is 'deprecated'.

replacedBy.description: Successor scenario or recipe file stem (e.g., 'order-checkout-v2'). Required when status is 'deprecated'.

removalDate.description: Target date for removing the deprecated version. Optional even when deprecated.

status.description: Matches when status is deprecated to enforce additional required fields
